author: packs
description: Manufacturing (X6-T1), the commercial and after-sales side; production, bills of materials, inventory and costing stay in the ERP and MES: customer sites, sales agreements with planned and actual volumes, rebate programmes with accruals and payouts, tenders with local-content scores, samples, quality complaints through 8D stages and product compliance documents. Cost and margin fields are masked. Roles, report queries and a sidebar.

definition.name: Commercial Manager
Manufacturing: Agreement Volume vs Plan
definition.sql: SELECT agreement_ref, period_label, SUM(planned_quantity) AS planned, SUM(actual_quantity) AS actual FROM mfg_agreement_line WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) GROUP BY agreement_ref, period_label ORDER BY period_label

definition.name: Manufacturing: Open Quality Complaints by Stage
definition.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS complaints FROM mfg_quality_complaint WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND status NOT IN ('d8_close', 'rejected') GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

target.query: Manufacturing: Open Quality Complaints by Stage

definition.name: Manufacturing: Tenders Due
definition.sql: SELECT id, title, tender_number, submission_deadline, status FROM mfg_tender WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND status IN ('identified', 'preparing') ORDER BY submission_deadline
